items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces with scheme theoretic image Z and a point z of |Z|, there is a valuation ring A with fraction field K and a commutative diagram Spec(K) -> X over Spec(A) -> Z -> Y whose closed point maps to z (source lines 3307-3321). The proof descends the scheme version: it picks an affine V etale over Y hitting z, notes that the scheme theoretic image Z' of X x_Y V -> V is Z x_Y V so that z lifts, uses quasi-compactness to cover X x_Y V by an affine etale W, applies the scheme case to W -> V, and composes back down to X.
